title: G7 finance chiefs say it is urgent to limit Middle East war’s cost to global economy
byline: Finance chiefs of the Group of Seven nations on Thursday said it was urgent to limit the cost to the global economy of an enduring Middle East war and “reaffirmed the pressing need ⁠to move toward a lasting peace.”

title: Trump says he may go to Islamabad if Iran deal reached
byline: US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that if a deal with Iran to conclude the war is reached and signed in Islamabad, he might go, and that Iran has agreed to almost everything.

title: Registration of Persons Dept. services suspended today due to system failure
byline: The Ministry of Digital Economy has announced that all public services of the Department for Registration of Persons (ID Office) have been temporarily suspended today (17) following an unexpected system breakdown.

title: OpenAI launches AI model GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
byline: OpenAI on Thursday introduced an artificial intelligence model touting increased biology knowledge and scientific research capabilities, as the startup deepens its push into the life sciences field.

title: Showers expected in several provinces after 1pm today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and Uva provinces and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 1.00 pm, the Department of Meteorology stated.

title: Ministry issues notice on implementation of Grade 1 education reforms
byline: The distribution of activity books for Grade 1, covering the second and third terms for the year 2026, has already commenced, according to the Ministry of Education.

title: Attempted shooting targeting “Podi Patty” reported in Ahungalla
byline: A shooting incident targeting an individual known as “Podi Patty,” the brother of organized criminal figure “Loku Patty,” has been reported in the Ahungalla area.

title: First crude oil tanker since Middle East conflict to arrive today
byline: Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminals Limited (CPSTL) has announced that the first crude oil tanker to arrive in Sri Lanka since the outbreak of the Middle East conflicts is scheduled to arrive today (17).

title: Navy seizes 10 multi-day fishing trawlers linked to drug trafficking in first quarter
byline: The Sri Lanka Navy has seized a total of 10 local multi-day fishing trawlers involved in drug trafficking during the first three months of this year.

title: Iran has agreed to hand over its enriched uranium supply, says Trump
byline: US President Donald Trump said Thursday (Apr 16) that Iran has agreed to hand over its store of enriched uranium and that the two sides were “close” to a peace deal to end the war that has engulfed the Middle East.

title: Eight people killed in helicopter crash in Indonesia’s West Kalimantan
byline: All eight people on board a helicopter were killed when it crashed in Indonesia’s West Kalimantan province, authorities said on Friday as search teams tried to retrieve the bodies and wreckage.

title: Global oil prices dip as fragile Israel-Lebanon truce announced
byline: Global oil prices retreated slightly on Friday morning in Asia after a ceasefire between Lebanon and Israel came into effect.

title: Six bodies recovered following drowning incident at Deduru Oya
byline: Six bodies—comprising two females and four males—have been recovered from among a group of individuals who were reportedly swept away while bathing in the Deduru Oya in the Kuratiyagahamula area of Kobeigane.

title: Multi-day fishing vessel with suspected narcotics brought to Dikkowita Harbour
byline: UPDATE: The Police Narcotics Bureau (PNB) has confirmed that the substance recovered from the local multi-day fishing vessel is heroin.

title: Over 150 kg of heroin worth Rs. 4 bln found on seized fishing trawler off Southern Seas
byline: Over 150 kilograms of heroin, valued at around Rs. 4 billion, have been recovered from a fishing trawler seized by the Sri Lanka Navy and brought to the Dikowita Fisheries Harbour this morning (17).

title: Nuwara Eliya PS chairman’s bail application rejected
byline: The Colombo Magistrate’s Court has rejected the bail application of the Chairman of the Nuwara Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha, Velu Yogaraj, who is currently in remand custody over corruption allegations.

title: Deduru Oya drowning incident: Death toll rises to 8 as last two bodies recovered
byline: Sri Lanka Police have confirmed that the recovery of the last two bodies from the Deduru Oya drowning incident has brought the death toll to eight.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Southern Province and in Colombo, Kaluthara, Monaragala and Rathnapura districts.

title: Trump says Iran war should end ‘soon’, both sides may meet at weekend
byline: US President Donald Trump expressed confidence that an agreement could soon be reached to end the Iran war and urged the Tehran-aligned Hezbollah group to hold its fire as a 10-day truce went in to effect between Lebanon and Israel.

title: Indian Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan to visit Sri Lanka
byline: The Vice President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, is scheduled to undertake an official visit to Sri Lanka from April 19 to 20, 2026.

title: Vijay unveils TVK’s manifesto; promises free gas cylinders
byline: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) chief and actor Vijay on Thursday unveiled the party’s election manifesto, promising Rs 2,500 monthly assistance for women and 8 gm gold and silk saree for every bride from families with annual income below Rs 5 lakh for if voted into power in the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections scheduled for April 23.

title: President appoints commission to probe alleged irregularities in Lanka Coal Company
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has appointed a Commission of Inquiry to investigate whether irregularities or illegal acts occurred within the state-owned Lanka Coal Company (Pvt) Ltd ...

title: Special train services scheduled to operate for passengers returning to Colombo
byline: The Railway Department has deployed several special train services for the public returning to Colombo after visiting their hometowns for the Sinhala and Tamil New Year.

title: Audi, SAIC will jointly develop future models under new China brand
byline: Audi will deepen its partnership with China’s SAIC for future generations of models under their co-owned new brand, with ⁠four of them to be launched in China in the coming years, the company said in a statement on Friday.

title: Sarath Kongahage and Devapriya Abeysinghe granted bail
byline: The former Chairman of the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation (SLRC), Sarath Kongahage and the former Director General, Devapriya Abeysinghe who were arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC), have been granted bail by the Colombo Magistrate’s Court.

title: Special bus services deployed for passengers returning to Colombo after New Year
byline: The National Transport Commission (NTC) has announced that special bus services have commenced today for the public returning to Colombo after the Sinhala and Tamil New Year holidays.

title: Former SriLankan CEO Kapila Chandrasena further remanded after bail refusal
byline: The Colombo Magistrate’s Court today ordered the refusal of the bail application of former SriLankan Airlines Chief Executive Officer Kapila Chandrasena, who is currently in remand custody in connection with an incident involving the alleged acceptance of bribes during the purchase of Airbus aircraft for the airline.

title: QR code fuel quota system for petrol vehicles to resume from midnight tomorrow
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has announced that the temporary suspension of the QR code-based fuel quota system for petrol-powered vehicles will come to an end from midnight tomorrow (18).

title: Diesel purchased above $286; CPC denies high crude oil price claims
byline: Chairman of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), D. J. Rajakaruna, has firmly rejected claims that Sri Lanka procured crude oil at a price exceeding $286 per barrel when importing fuel to Sri Lanka.

title: Sri Lanka among worst impacted countries in Asia-Pacific due to West Asia conflict: UN report
byline: Sri Lanka is among the worst impacted countries in the Asia-Pacific due to the ripple effects of the West Asia crisis, a UN report said.

title: Energy Minister Kumara Jayakody and Ministry Secretary resign from posts
byline: Power and Energy Minister Kumara Jayakody and Ministry Secretary Prof. Udayanga Hemapala have resigned from their respective positions.

title: Iran rejects temporary ceasefire, seeks end to war across region: Deputy Minister
byline: Iran’s Deputy Foreign Minister Saeed Khatibzadeh said Tehran rejects any temporary ceasefire and is seeking a comprehensive end to the war across the region.

title: Anyone can provide information to commission probing coal imports – Minister
byline: Minister Vijitha Herath today categorically rejected claims that any fraud had taken place in the importation of coal, but admitted that the imported coal shipment was of substandard quality.

title: IMF chief reaffirms continued support for Sri Lanka’s economic recovery
byline: The Sri Lankan delegation, headed by the Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, Dr Nandalal Weerasinghe, has engaged in productive discussions with the senior leadership of the International Monetary Fund, World Bank Group, as well as with rating agencies and investors during the IMF-WB Spring Meetings 2026.

title: New Secretary appointed to Ministry of Energy
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has appointed Senior Additional Secretary to the President Mr. G.M.R.D. Aponsu as the new Secretary to the Ministry of Energy.

title: President appoints commission to probe alleged irregularities in coal procurement
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has appointed a Commission of Inquiry to investigate whether irregularities or illegal acts occurred within the state-owned Lanka Coal Company (Pvt) Ltd ...

title: President Anura Kumara reviews ‘Clean Sri Lanka’ 2026 Action Plan
byline: A special discussion on the Action Plan of the ‘Clean Sri Lanka’ programme 2026 and the progress achieved in the previous year was held this morning (17) at the Presidential Secretariat under the patronage of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake.

title: Trump says ‘thank you’ after Iran announces opening of Strait of Hormuz
byline: Iran and US declare Strait of Hormuz “completely open,” but Iran adds that passage is on a “coordinated route” set by Tehran.

title: Int’l firm to conduct forensic audit into NDB internal fraud – CBSL
byline: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) says that it continues to closely monitor on a day-to-day basis developments relating to National Development Bank PLC (NDB) following the disclosure of an internal fraud.

title: Owner of fishing boat seized with over 160kg heroin arrested
byline: Police have arrested the owner of the multi-day fishing vessel seized by the Sri Lanka Navy while transporting a haul of drugs in the deep sea, about 400 nautical miles south of the island.

title: Oil prices plunge as Iran says Strait of Hormuz ‘open’ during ceasefire
byline: Oil prices have plummeted after Iran said the Strait of Hormuz would be “completely open” to commercial ships for the remainder of the ceasefire.

title: Energy Minister’s resignation a bit too late – Namal
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organiser MP Namal Rajapaksa says that Energy Minister Kumara Jayakody’s resignation, although welcome, comes a bit too late.
